text: Tribal Power's workshops are called **Echo stations**. Each one needs three things close together: something to work on, Pulse to spend, and the right **Resonance Totem** nearby to give it its voice.

The first station you want is [Echo Shatter](echo_shatter): seven stone around a Bone Chime and a Copper Resonator. Four copper ingots around a Bone Chime make **two** Copper Resonators. It breaks stone into an **Echo Shard**, the little crystal that will let you make power without drumming.

Shatter needs the **Earth** voice. Craft a {item:tribalpower:resonance_totem_earth} from logs, dirt, a Bone Chime and a Copper Resonator, and stand it near the station. The totem is not a power source. Think of it as the station's teacher: without it, the station waits and spends nothing.

A totem stands **two blocks tall**, so leave a free block above the spot. Click either half; breaking either half takes the whole totem. A totem from an older world grows its top back once the block above it is clear.

steps.caption: Put Echo Shatter down beside your Drumheart.
Add an Earth Resonance Totem within 8 blocks. Right beside it is simplest.
Open Shatter and put in stone. Cobblestone only gives gravel, so smelt it first.
Keep the drum charged. In a few seconds an Echo Shard comes out.

pages.title: If it will not start
text: Crouch and right-click the station with this book. It will say whether it lacks Pulse, its totem, or room in its output.
Shatter spends Pulse faster than a hand drum makes it, so drum a reserve first and let the drum carry the work.
A lever or any steady redstone signal pauses a station. Nothing is lost while it waits.
